svg.title: A tumor's acid clears out healthy tissue
svg.desc: Snapshots of the simulation at steps 0, 40, 80 and 120. Healthy cells are green, tumor cells orange, capillaries dark dots. A ring of empty tissue spreads out ahead of the tumor, and the acid map shows acid filling that ring.
svg.text: Dark dots: capillaries. Light gray: empty.
Acid map: deeper orange = more lactate.
Healthy cells die above 1; tumor cells
The acid runs ahead of the tumor and
empties the tissue it will grow into.
